prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ createRepairDesk }`. `createRepairDesk(notify)` requires a function and returns `open(summary, owner)`, `assign(ticketId, technician)`, `close(ticketId)`, `list(status)`, and `drainNotices()`. Text arguments must be non-empty strings after trimming. Ticket IDs are deterministic positive integers starting at 1. New tickets have status `open` and technician `null`; assignment changes status to `assigned`; closing changes it to `closed`. Assigning a closed ticket or closing an already closed ticket throws `RangeError`; an unknown ID throws `RangeError`. Every successful status change calls `notify` synchronously with a fresh `{ ticketId, owner, status }` object and queues an identical notice. If `notify` throws, the operation must leave all state unchanged. `list` accepts `all`, `open`, `assigned`, or `closed`, returns ID-ordered fresh ticket objects, and rejects other values. `drainNotices` returns fresh notice objects and clears the queue.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
